sn45.77:1.2: I. VIVEKANISSITAṂo 2. Nāham bhikkhave aññam ekadhammam pi samanupassāmi || yena anuppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo uppajjati || uppanno vā a- a- maggo bhāvanāpāripūrim gacchati || yathayidam bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā || || 3.
sn45.77:1.3: Kalyāṇamittassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkham a- a- maggam bhāvessati a- a- maggam bahulīkarissati || ||
sn45.77:1.4: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto a- amaggam bhāveti a- a- maggam bahulīkaroti || || 4.
sn45.77:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ || la-pe || sammāsamādhim bhāveti viveka- virāganirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn45.77:1.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto a- a- maggam bhāveti a- amaggam bahulīkarotī ti || || 2.
